body:
From MMR-35 (accepted): every hull a generated shipyard builds has a chain verified against the installed files. It runs from the mission ship through its nested prefab (`NavalDLC/AssetPackages/nested_prefabs_packed.xml`) to the deck navmesh its `MissionShip` script names (`NavMeshPrefabs/<NavMeshPrefabName>.bin`), plus slots and siege engines.

What was not verified is mission-time: crew, captain and reinforcement spawn points (`sp_troop_captain`, `sp_troop_crew_spawn`, `sp_troop_inner_deck`/`outer_deck`, `spawnpoint_ship_reinforcement`) live in the prefab's nested links and resolve only when a naval mission builds the ship. `GameEntity.PrefabExists` is false for every ship prefab on the campaign map (run 6636). A naval battle or raid on a generated world should check these.
